fields.name: report_date
fields.hint: the date the report was written, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: approach_used
fields.hint: the valuation approach stated on the report

fields.name: reconciled_value
fields.hint: the final reconciled value opinion, no currency symbol or commas

fields.name: gross_living_area_sqft
fields.hint: the subject's gross living area in square feet

fields.name: comparable_count
fields.hint: how many comparable sales the report states it used

fields.name: extraordinary_assumption_present
fields.hint: does the report state an extraordinary assumption ANYWHERE in its text -- under a dedicated 'Extraordinary Assumptions' heading, OR embedded in the prose of another section (Scope of Work, Comments, etc.)? Read the whole report; do not check only a labelled section.

fields.name: extraordinary_assumption_text
fields.hint: the extraordinary assumption's text, copied verbatim from wherever it appears, or null if the report states none
